grammar.title: گذشتهٔ ساده
grammar.explain: Persian combines ezafe noun phrases, object marker را, analytic and prefixed aspect, compound verbs, subjunctive and conditional forms, SOV information structure, politeness, and prosody. Choices encode reference, time, evidence, focus, and register.
grammar.pattern: topic + marked object/complements + aspect/modal material + final verb

examples.t: شنبه از موزه دیدن کردیم و بعد ناهار خوردیم.
examples.r: shnbh z mwzh dydn khrdym w b`d nhr khwrdym.
examples.en: On Saturday we visited the museum and then ate lunch.

examples.t: آن‌ها اکنون در حال آماده کردن شام و گوش دادن به خبرها هستند.
examples.r: anh khnwn dr Hl amdh khrdn shm w gwsh ddn bh khbrh hstnd.
examples.en: They are preparing dinner and listening to the news now.

examples.t: قطار سریع‌تر است، اما اتوبوس ارزان‌تر است.
examples.r: qTr sry`tr st, m twbws rzntr st.
examples.en: The train is faster, but the bus is cheaper.

mistakes.wrong: Form with missing ezafe, را, or mismatched verb stem
mistakes.right: شنبه از موزه دیدن کردیم و بعد ناهار خوردیم.
mistakes.why: The corrected model aligns Persian morphology and discourse meaning.
